newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkey aims to keep inflation below 90 percent.
newsitem.headline: Turkey aims to keep inflation below 90 percent.

text.p: Turkey aims to keep inflation below 90 percent, a treasury official said.
"What is in our minds is to keep it (inflation) from passing 90 percent," treasury undersecretary Mahfi Egilmez told reporters.
Annual inflation is currently more than 80 percent.
Speaking after a monetary council meeting, Egilmez said financial markets had reacted positively to a recent cooperation accord between the treasury and the central bank.
"After the central bank protocol, a very positive wind has been blowing, especially in foreign markets," he said.
He said work was continuing on developing new borrowing instruments but declined to give further details.
